title: Verify coordinated upgrade CLI and recovery boundaries
outcome: Independent CLI tests exercise complete prepare/activate/finalize or rollback flows on isolated stores and reject contradictory recovery without touching originals.
acceptance: CLI refuses missing offline acknowledgement and preserves an established source during prepare; committed WAL data survives the full flow.
Isolated end-to-end tests verify activated content, retained original and executable, repeat/recovery behavior, and rollback refusal after the durable resume boundary.
Required gates and exact Codex/Claude pair pass on the final input with process-crash versus power-loss limitations explicitly reported.

blockers.detail: Completion accounting awaits the required tests-first child's historical criterion-3 decision. V7 gates/review/rehearsal and Coder follow-up remain accepted with their recorded limits; no duplicate gate run is needed merely for cleanup.

disposal_reason: Obsolete: the coordinated prepare/activate/finalize/rollback CLI it verifies was removed in 54285f2; the current one-way export/import has its own coverage under the surviving parent scope. Triage 2026-09-27, consultation Engram::Fable, Termal::Fable, Engram::Coder, unanimous.
